description: This file implements a Kubernetes controller for managing ServiceCIDRs, including event handling, synchronization, finalizer management, and status updates.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: A Kubernetes controller for managing ServiceCIDRs, handling events, synchronization, finalizer management, and status updates.

methods.name: NewController
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Controller instance with event handlers and informers.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller's worker routines and manages lifecycle until context is canceled.

methods.name: addServiceCIDR
methods.description: Handles addition of a ServiceCIDR resource, enqueuing it and overlapping CIDRs.

methods.name: updateServiceCIDR
methods.description: Handles updates to a ServiceCIDR resource, enqueuing the updated key.

methods.name: deleteServiceCIDR
methods.description: Handles deletion of a ServiceCIDR resource, enqueuing its key.

methods.name: addIPAddress
methods.description: Handles addition of an IPAddress, enqueuing containing CIDRs.

methods.name: deleteIPAddress
methods.description: Handles deletion of an IPAddress, enqueuing containing CIDRs.

methods.name: overlappingServiceCIDRs
methods.description: Returns a list of ServiceCIDRs that overlap with or contain the given ServiceCIDR.

methods.name: containingServiceCIDRs
methods.description: Returns a list of ServiceCIDRs that contain the given IPAddress.

methods.name: worker
methods.description: Processes items from the work queue.

methods.name: processNext
methods.description: Processes the next item in the queue, handling retries and errors.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the state of a ServiceCIDR, managing finalizers and status conditions.

methods.name: canDeleteCIDR
methods.description: Checks if a ServiceCIDR can be safely deleted without orphaning IPAddresses.

methods.name: addServiceCIDRFinalizerIfNeeded
methods.description: Adds a finalizer to a ServiceCIDR if not already present.

methods.name: removeServiceCIDRFinalizerIfNeeded
methods.description: Removes the finalizer from a ServiceCIDR if present.

methods.name: updateConditionIfNeeded
methods.description: Updates the status condition of a ServiceCIDR if it differs from the current.

methods.name: convertToV1IPFamily
methods.description: Converts a netutils.IPFamily to a v1.IPFamily.
